title: Time car test in an empty parking lot
place: A mall parking lot at night, a stainless-steel gull-wing sports car with glowing coils racing toward a camcorder, fire trails behind
situation: A wild-haired inventor tests a time car that must hit a precise speed; it vanishes in a flash, leaving flaming tire tracks
cast: wild-haired inventor in a radiation suit
visualTropes: a dashboard of glowing date displays
jokeHooks: the machine only works at an exact speed, like a test that only passes with a specific seed
the date display is set to the wrong timezone and the car lands an hour late
the inventor runs the experiment in production with the dog inside

title: Dinosaur stampede
place: A prehistoric valley of ferns and volcanoes, a herd of long-necked and horned dinosaurs stampeding, a brass time pod smoking in a crater
situation: Time tourists sprint for their pod as a stampede thunders past and a big carnivore shoves its head in the hatch
cast: safari guide in a pith helmet
visualTropes: a volcano erupting in the background
a hatch slammed on a snout
jokeHooks: stepping on one butterfly changes a dependency far downstream
the time pod needs a full restart while dinosaurs bite the hatch
the tourist's photos auto-upload to a cloud that will not exist for millions of years

title: Arrival in a historic street
place: A muddy medieval market street, a humming metal time booth appearing in a flash of light between a goat pen and a blacksmith
situation: Two time travelers in modern clothes step out into a crowd of stunned peasants and try to blend in
visualTropes: a booth fading in with sparkles
a smartphone held up like a relic
jokeHooks: the travelers bring their own runtime into an environment that never heard of it
they search for wifi in the twelfth century, like an agent with no network
the booth parks in exactly the wrong spot, a hardcoded coordinate

title: Meeting yourself
place: A suburban street at a school dance night, the same person appearing three times in different outfits hiding behind bushes and cars
situation: A time traveler must fix the past without being seen by their past self, but two other future selves are already there
cast: future self in a silver suit
visualTropes: a photo where people fade out
jokeHooks: three versions of the same branch tripping over each other in a merge
the future self says do not touch that, and present self touches it anyway
a fading photo is a failing check fading from green to red

title: Time machine crashes into the arena
place: A packed ancient arena with sand floor, gladiators and lions, an emperor in a box, a smoking time machine crashed in the middle
situation: The time machine lands mid-games; the crowd thinks it is part of the show and the emperor demands a fight
visualTropes: a crowd giving thumbs up and down
a time machine half buried in sand
jokeHooks: the emperor's thumbs-up or thumbs-down is code review
the machine's error log is written in modern English nobody here can read
the crowd thinks the crash is a planned demo

title: Cluttered time machine workshop
place: A garage lab with dozens of clocks all reading different times, a brass-and-crystal machine with a seat, sparks and a chalkboard of equations
situation: An inventor flips the big lever for the first time and every clock in the room spins backward
visualTropes: a crystal glowing in the machine
a cat flickering between kitten and old cat
jokeHooks: every clock disagrees, like servers with clock drift
the lever is the deploy button and nobody has a rollback
the cat flickers between versions like a flaky dependency

title: Arrival in a gleaming future city
place: A shiny future city of floating towers, flying cars in neat lanes, moving walkways, robots walking dogs, holographic billboards
situation: A time traveler from the past gawks at everything and tries to pay with cash while robots politely escort them
visualTropes: a moving walkway carrying a startled person
jokeHooks: everything here runs on a framework the traveler has never heard of
the future still has a loading spinner
the robot guide reads the traveler's terms of service aloud

title: Time police chase through the eras
place: A swirling corridor of eras where a chase jumps from a jungle to a 1920s street to a space station panel by panel
situation: Time police chase a rogue traveler who keeps jumping eras, each leap arriving with a crash in a new century
cast: stern time cop with a badge
visualTropes: a badge glowing with a clock
jokeHooks: chasing a bug that hops across environments
each jump leaves a stack trace in a different language
the rogue rewrites history like a force-push

title: Lost in the ice age
place: A white glacial plain under a pale sun, woolly mammoths and saber-toothed cats, a frozen time machine half buried in snow
situation: Travelers in summer clothes try to thaw their machine with a campfire while a tribe of fur-clad hunters watches
visualTropes: a time machine encased in ice
jokeHooks: the machine is frozen like a pinned dependency nobody can upgrade
thawing it takes as long as a cold cache warmup
the hunters' cave paintings document the machine better than the official docs

title: Pushing a train toward a broken bridge
place: A steam train racing across a desert, a time car pushing it from behind on the rails, a ravine with an unfinished bridge ahead
situation: Travelers must push a train to an impossible speed to get home before it plunges into the ravine
visualTropes: colored logs blasting in the firebox
a car glued to the rails
jokeHooks: the logs burn hotter like adding more CI runners
the bridge is the integration nobody built yet
the plan works only if every step hits on time, like a chain of dependent jobs

title: Masked ball in another century
place: A candlelit palace ballroom full of powdered wigs, silk gowns, an orchestra, and a time traveler in a costume that is almost right
situation: Travelers infiltrate a royal ball to retrieve a lost gadget from a noble's wig before history changes
cast: time traveler in a too-modern costume
visualTropes: a gadget blinking in a wig
jokeHooks: the costume looks right except for sneakers, like a passing test with one mocked call
the gadget beeps through every waltz like a forgotten debug log
changing one dance partner rewrites the entire guest list downstream

title: Timeline collapse
place: A street dissolving into fragments, buildings from different centuries overlapping, clocks raining from a cracked sky
situation: A paradox tears reality apart; the travelers must reach the machine as the world glitches between eras
visualTropes: buildings overlapping like a double exposure
jokeHooks: two conflicting migrations run at once and history renders both
the fix is to roll back the one change that started the paradox
every era glitches like a page with two versions of the same library

title: Pyramid construction site
place: A vast desert construction site with ramps, huge stone blocks on sledges, thousands of workers and overseers, a half-built pyramid
situation: Time travelers arrive with modern advice for the builders, who politely ignore them and keep hauling
jokeHooks: the architect's plan is a monolith and the traveler pitches microservices
the traveler's tablet battery dies, leaving the ancient process standing
the build takes twenty years, longer even than the CI

title: Observatory at the end of time
place: A domed observatory floating at the end of the universe, a giant window showing the last stars fading, a gramophone playing
situation: Travelers reach the final moment of time and find a lonely caretaker who has been waiting to close up
jokeHooks: the caretaker is the last maintainer of a project everyone else forgot
the guest book lists every deprecated feature
even here, a final cleanup job is still running
